content.title: American Rebel to effect 1-for-25 reverse stock split on March 31
content.summary: American Rebel (AREB) Holdings will effect a reverse stock split of its outstanding shares of common stock, par value $0.001 per share, at a ratio of 1-for-25, to be effective as of 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time on March 31, 2025 as per NASDAQ. The Company’s Common Stock will begin trading on a reverse stock split-adjusted basis at the opening of The Nasdaq Capital Market on Monday, March 31, 2025. content.summary: The latest announcement is out from American Rebel Holdings ( (AREB) ). Despite these hurdles, the company is actively negotiating solutions to avoid severe impacts on its working capital and business operations.
